title: Modernising the Australian Army’s Land Systems
summary: Providence, A Tetra Tech Company supported the Australian Army's Land C4 modernisation initiatives through systems engineering, technical assurance, integration, and project leadership services, strengthening capability delivery outcomes.
body_markdown:
Providence, A Tetra Tech Company supported the Australian Army’s Land C4 modernisation initiatives through systems engineering, technical assurance, integration, and project leadership services, strengthening capability delivery outcomes.


## Challenge


The Australian Army sought to modernise key command, control, communications, and information systems capabilities to support evolving operational requirements. Complex integration activities, multiple stakeholders, technical assurance requirements, and capability delivery objectives required robust engineering governance and independent systems engineering expertise to support successful outcomes.


## Solution


Tetra Tech embedded experienced systems engineers, project leaders, and technical specialists within Army’s Land Command, Control, Communications and Computer Systems environment. Working across communications modernisation initiatives, the team delivered systems engineering oversight, integration support, technical assurance, governance, certification activities, and stakeholder engagement to support capability delivery. Our personnel occupied key technical and leadership positions, helping Defence strengthen engineering decision-making, manage technical risk, and improve confidence in capability outcomes across a complex operating environment.


## Benefits


- Strengthened Army communications capability delivery
- Improved engineering governance and assurance
- Supported certification and capability acceptance activities
- Embedded skilled engineering leadership within Defence programs
